sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Make the Table 6-6 and Table 6-7 lookup selections unambiguous and non-combinatorial: require exactly one qualifying nltl:hasTableLookupCase for each cited table (add sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 alongside each qualifiedMinCount 1), and constrain each qualifying case's nltl:tableReference to sh:maxCount 1. This prevents one case from claiming both tables and prevents the formula query from cross-joining multiple independently selected N_class or k_1 values. rows: Make nltl:lookupSelectionEvidence mandatory on every tableLookupCase (sh:minCount 1, retaining its evidenceArtifact class constraint). The COMPLETE dependency contract declares this tableLookupCase-to-evidenceArtifact model path and relationship/evidence role; the current optional property permits table selections with no required selection evidence.

Add sh:class qudt:QuantityValue to each quantity-value node constraint for iceLoadCycleCoefficientK1, iceLoadCycleCoefficientK2, iceLoadCycleCoefficientK3, propellerBladeLoadSpectrumCountFactor, selectedIceClassCycleCount, and selectedPropellerLocationFactor. Their canonical range is qudt:QuantityValue; numericValue/unit subproperties alone do not enforce that required range.

Make the Table 6-6 and Table 6-7 lookup selections unambiguous and non-combinatorial: require exactly one qualifying nltl:hasTableLookupCase for each cited table (add sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 alongside each qualifiedMinCount 1), and constrain each qualifying case's nltl:tableReference to sh:maxCount 1. This prevents one case from claiming both tables and prevents the formula query from cross-joining multiple independently selected N_class or k_1 values.
